name: K1 Professional
summary: Top-tier configuration of Booster Robotics' K1 humanoid platform: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 32GB compute (200 TOPS), a 5Ah battery (Booster: about 1 h 10 min walking at 1.1 m/s; RobotShop EU listing: ~80 min at 0.4 m/s), and a 12-month manufacturer warranty with 1-year technical support plus access to the Education Solution. Positioned for research teams, advanced development programs, and professional real-world deployment. Source: RobotShop EU listing, 2026-08-16.
specs_note: Entered by robert@humanoid.company from https://eu.robotshop.com/collections/booster-robotics (retrieved 2026-08-16). 10 field(s) not stated by the source and left UNKNOWN. ros_support and simulation_support are recorded TRUE per the source's own comparison table ('Yes' for both) -- but the same page's 'Open Software Stack' section qualifies this platform-wide: 'ROS 2 or Isaac-Sim support may require developer integration rather than being fully built in.' Treat both as SDK-level capability, not out-of-the-box support. AI compute (Jetson AGX Orin 32GB, 200 TOPS) and warranty (12 months, 1-year technical support, Education Solution access) have no dedicated catalogue field and are recorded in `summary` instead. NOTE: source_url is RobotShop EU's Booster Robotics COLLECTION page, not the exact per-SKU product URL -- the precise product-page URL has been requested from the owner and should replace this citation once supplied. CORRECTION 2026-10-19 (owner decision; docs/discovery/K1_SPEED_RUNTIME_CORRECTION_PROPOSAL_2026-10-19.md): walk_speed_ms is now Booster's stated walking speed, 'Walking Speed: 2 m/s', read as up to 2 m/s (discovery claim f79a4674); the previous 0.4 m/s was the RobotShop listing's runtime-test speed, not a walking speed. runtime_minutes is Booster's own observation, '1 h 10 min (walking at 1.1 m/s)' (claim 57368c23), from https://www.booster.tech/booster-k1?target=en observed 2026-10-18. The RobotShop EU listing's alternative observation, '~80 min runtime at 0.4 m/s' (retrieved 2026-08-16), is preserved in the runtime caveat; the two were measured at different speeds and are not interchangeable. SPECIFICATIONS (HO-DATA-30 batch 3, 2026-10-22): has_teleoperation filled from first-party Booster Robotics sources, each quoted in spec_caveats. Capability booleans are set only where the manufacturer states the capability in words (HO-DATA-30 authoring criteria, docs/audit/HO-DATA-30_FEASIBILITY_AND_BATCH3_2026-10-22.md); a negative only where it is stated in words. use_case_fits.notes: The distributor listing positions this configuration for research teams and advanced development programs, with Jetson AGX Orin compute, ROS2 compatibility and Isaac Sim simulation support (https://eu.robotshop.com/collections/booster-robotics, observed 2026-08-16).
use_case_fits.limitations: The listing also mentions professional real-world deployment; no deployment is recorded, so none is claimed. ROS 2 / Isaac Sim may require developer integration. Payload and manipulation are not stated. Third-party distributor source.

use_case_fits.notes: Editorial judgement. The K1 platform is a robot-soccer competition platform (the distributor cites a RoboCup 2025 KidSize championship for the K1 line), with voice interaction recorded: a potential fit for competitions and live demonstrations.
use_case_fits.limitations: A development platform, not a purpose-built entertainment product. Demonstrations or exhibitions are a potential use, not an established event-service capability. 95 cm platform, about 70 min runtime walking at 1.1 m/s per Booster (~80 min at 0.4 m/s per RobotShop).

spec_caveats.text: Booster states 'Walking Speed: 2 m/s' (up to 2 m/s; claim f79a4674). A manufacturer specification, not a measured cruising speed.
Booster: '1 h 10 min (walking at 1.1 m/s)' (claim 57368c23). RobotShop EU listing (retrieved 2026-08-16): '~80 min runtime at 0.4 m/s'. Measured at different speeds; not interchangeable.

Booster Robotics states 'Handheld remote controller: Available' / 'Handheld Controller. Responsive and easy to use. Use the thumbsticks to control walking and turning' (https://www.booster.tech/booster-k1). Operator remote control with Booster's handheld controller.
